programme.title: Newshour
programme.desc: News Hour is a flagship hourly news programme from Al Jazeera Media Network that delivers comprehensive global coverage of breaking developments, politics, business, climate, and human interest stories. Anchored by experienced journalists and supported by an extensive network of international correspondents, the show provides live updates, expert analysis, and in-depth reports. It connects audiences to events as they unfold, offering clarity, context, and multiple perspectives on the stories shaping the world each day.

programme.title: News Live
programme.desc: News Live is a rolling news programme from Al Jazeera Media Network delivering up-to-the-minute coverage of breaking stories from around the world. Anchored by experienced journalists and supported by correspondents across continents, it brings viewers live reports, expert interviews, and on-the-ground updates as events unfold. From major political developments and conflicts to business, climate, and human interest stories, the programme keeps audiences informed with accurate, timely, and comprehensive global news coverage.

programme.title: Counting the Cost
programme.desc: Counting the Cost is a weekly business and economics programme from Al Jazeera Media Network that examines the global forces shaping markets, trade, and livelihoods. With in-depth analysis and reporting from across continents, the show breaks down complex financial trends, corporate power, policy decisions, and emerging industries. It connects boardroom strategies to real-world consequences, revealing how economic shifts affect communities, workers, and consumers in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Let's Focus
programme.desc: Designed for viewers seeking context, depth and clarity, Let's Focus unpacks the U.S. midterm elections and treats audiences as citizens rather than spectators.
